## Core Services

### 1. Grand Wedding Catering & Banana Leaf Virundhu
- Traditional authentic 26+ item South Indian banana leaf wedding feast.
- Prepared with 100% pure cold-pressed oils, pure cow ghee, and zero artificial preservatives.
- Specialized in Tamil Brahmin, Kongu Nadu, Chettinad, and contemporary fusion menus.

### 2. 19+ Interactive Live Food Stalls
- **Interactive Theater**: Live Pani Puri & Chaat Counter, Chocolate Fountain with Marshmallow & Fruit Skewers, 90s Nostalgia Petty Shop, Live Kulfi & Ice Cream Bar, Royal Sweet Meetha Paan Station.
- **Beverage & Botanical Bars**: Live Fresh Sugar Cane Juice Counter, Tender Coconut Water Bar, Botanical Herbal Mocktail Station, Traditional Kumbakonam Degree Filter Coffee & Brass Urn Tea.
- **Live Cooking Stations**: Sizzling Dosa Variations, Live Appam & Stew, Malabar Parotta with Salna, Live Pasta & Indo-Chinese Counters.

### 3. Royal Buffet Architecture & Equipment Rentals
- Illuminated luxury food canopy corridors and royal arches.
- Premium heavy-gauge stainless steel roll-top chafing dishes and brass samovars.
- Full rental inventory of VVIP banquet dining tables, cushioned banquet chairs, commercial gas burners, and traditional copper cooking cauldrons.
